description: This source file defines the GatewayDiscoveryModel class which manages network gateway discovery using mDNS/Bonjour and other network protocols. It handles browsing for gateways, processing discovery results, resolving services, and maintaining a list of discovered gateways with detailed attributes.

classes.name: GatewayDiscoveryModel
classes.description: Main class responsible for discovering and managing gateway network services, including browsing, resolving, deduplication, and fallback mechanisms.

classes.name: ResolvedGatewayService
classes.description: Struct representing the resolved details of a network service, including TXT records, host, and port.

classes.name: GatewayServiceResolver
classes.description: Class that handles asynchronous resolution of network services via NetService, providing callback on resolution success or failure.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins network browsing for gateways across configured domains.

methods.name: refreshWideAreaFallbackNow
methods.description: Performs immediate discovery of wide-area gateways with specified timeout.

methods.name: refreshTailscaleServeFallbackNow
methods.description: Performs immediate discovery of Tailscale Serve gateways with specified timeout.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops all ongoing network discovery activities and clears internal state.

methods.name: mapWideAreaBeacons
methods.description: Transforms wide area beacon data into DiscoveredGateway instances.

methods.name: mapTailscaleServeBeacons
methods.description: Transforms Tailscale Serve beacon data into DiscoveredGateway instances.

methods.name: updateGateways
methods.description: Updates the list of gateways for a specific domain based on current results.

methods.name: updateGatewaysForAllDomains
methods.description: Updates gateways for all known domains.

methods.name: recomputeGateways
methods.description: Recomputes the final list of gateways based on current domain results and fallbacks.

methods.name: ensureServiceResolution
methods.description: Ensures resolution of a service given its identifiers, starting resolution if needed.
